description: Linn County replaced its utility-scale solar moratorium with siting rules in its Unified Development Code: solar equipment 300 ft from dwellings unless the owner waives it, 120 ft from perennial streams and ditches, 50 ft from property lines in the Renewable Energy overlay district; battery storage 200 ft from property lines and rights-of-way and 500 ft from off-site occupied structures unless waived; 55 dBA day and 50 dBA night noise limits; RE overlay rezoning and a passing score on the county's solar scorecard. Concentrating solar power is prohibited, and fenced arrays over 160 acres need a wildlife corridor.
mechanism_detail: setback: solar panels, structures and electrical equipment (excluding fences and interconnection lines) 300 ft from dwellings unless the owner waives it in writing (recorded); 120 ft from the centerline of perennial stream corridors and open ditches; 50 ft from property lines in the Renewable Energy overlay district (may be reduced to zero next to another overlay use). Battery energy storage: 200 ft from a property line or right-of-way; 500 ft from the nearest property line including an occupied structure off the subject property, reducible to 200 ft by a recorded, notarized waiver from that owner; 120 ft from perennial stream corridors and open ditches; sited inside a new solar facility when built with one. overlay_zone: rezoning to the Renewable Energy overlay district and the minimum passing threshold on the Linn County Utility Scale Solar Scorecard. noise_limit: hourly average 55 dBA by day (sunrise to sunset) and 50 dBA at night (sunset to sunrise) at the occupied dwelling of an adjacent residential property, or ambient Leq plus 5 dBA where ambient is higher; neighbours may waive in writing. Other: concentrating solar power (CSP) systems prohibited; fenced array areas over 160 acres require a wildlife corridor; panels at least 24 in. above ground at maximum tilt.
evidence_text: Solar panels, structures, and electrical equipment, excluding fences and power lines for interconnection, shall be kept a minimum of three hundred (300) feet from dwellings, unless the property owner waives the setback. Waiver must be in writing and recorded.
